     Streetman

     A.   ORDINANCE 09-2025-26 (FIRST READING) [ZONING CASE Z-31-2025]
          An Ordinance amending the zoning code and map of the City of Clarksville,
          application of Clarkland, for a zone change on property located on the northwest
          corner of Ashland City Rd./41-A Bypass and Denny Rd. Intersection from R-1
          Single Family Residential District to C-5 Highway & Arterial Commercial District.
          RPC: Approval/Approval

     B.   ORDINANCE 10-2025-26 (FIRST READING) [ZONING CASE Z-32-2025]
          An Ordinance amending the zoning code and map of the City of Clarksville,
          application of Ross & Ashley Morford / Armor Holdings LLC, for a zone change on
          two adjacent parcels on the northern frontage of Marion St., 115 ft +/- west of the
          2nd St & Marion St Intersection from R-4 Multiple Family Residential District to
          CBD Central Business District.
          RPC: Approval/Approval

     C.   ORDINANCE 11-2025-26 (FIRST READING) [ZONING CASE Z-33-2025]
          An Ordinance amending the zoning code and map of the City of Clarksville,
          application of Todd Morris, for a zone change on property consisting of four
          contiguous parcels, on the eastern frontage of Trenton Rd. 450 +/- north of Fairview
          Ln. from R-1 Single Family Residential District to R-4 Multiple Family Residential
          District / C-5 - Highway & Arterial Commercial District.
          RPC: Approval/Approval

D.   ORDINANCE 12-2025-26 (FIRST READING) [ZONING CASE Z-34-2025]
     An Ordinance amending the zoning code and map of the City of Clarksville,

E.   ORDINANCE 13-2025-26 (FIRST READING) [ZONING CASE Z-35-2025]
     An Ordinance amending the zoning code and map of the City of Clarksville,
     application of Tiny Town apartments LLC, for a zone change on property fronting
     the northern frontage of Tiny Town Rd, approximately 430 ft +/- west of Heritage
     Pointe Dr. from C-4 Highway Interchange District to C-2 General Commercial
     District. RPC: Approval/Approval

F.   ORDINANCE 14-2025-26 (FIRST READING) [ZONING CASE Z-36-2025]
     An Ordinance amending the zoning code and map of the City of Clarksville,
     application of Virginia James & Jason Feltner Family, for a zone change on
     property located on the eastern and western frontages of Ted A. Crozier Sr. Blvd.
     north and south of the western intersection of Dunlop Ln. & Ted Crozier Sr. Blvd. &
     1,800 +/- feet north of the eastern intersection of Dunlop Ln. & Ted Crozier Sr. Blvd.
     spanning 3,600 +/-feet of Ted Crozier Sr. Blvd. frontage, bounded by I-24 on the
     northeast & a railroad track to the south from R-1 Single Family Residential District
     / M-3 Light Industrial District to C-3 Regional Shopping Center District / C-4
     Highway Interchange District. RPC: Approval/Approval

G.   ORDINANCE 15-2025-26 (FIRST READING) [ZONING CASE Z-37-2025]
     An Ordinance amending the zoning code and map of the City of Clarksville,
     application of SDRA Holdings, LLC, for a zone change on property located on two
     parcels on the northwest corner of the Thomas St. & Bradley St. intersection from
     R-3 Three Family Residential District to C-2 -General Commercial District.
     RPC: Approval/Approval

H.   ORDINANCE 19-2025-26 (FIRST READING) [ZONING CASE ZO-7-2025]
     An Ordinance amending the City Zoning Ordinance of the City of Clarksville,
     Tennessee, as it pertains to updating the Clarksville Design Overlay Districts to
     include Fort Campbell Boulevard and Tiny Town Road Corridors. RPC: This
     amendment reduces the overall effect of the original ordinance. / None

I.   ORDINANCE 111-2024-25 (FIRST READING) [ZONING CASE Z-28-2025]
     (This item was granted a one-month deferral at the August 7, 2025 Regular Council
     Meeting in accordance with City Code Section 1-204)
     An Ordinance amending the zoning code and map of the City of Clarksville,
     application of Running M. Properties, LLC for a Zone change on property located
     south of W Concord Dr, east of Ft Campbell Blvd, and accessed approximately 260
     ft south of the Ft Campbell Blvd and Concord Dr intersection from C-2 General
     Commercial District to R-2A Single Family Residential District.
     RPC: Approval/Approval

8.   Consent Agenda
     All items in this portion of the agenda are considered to be routine and non-controversial
     by the Council and may be approved by one motion; however, a member of the Council
     may request that an item be removed for separate consideration under the appropriate
     committee report:

     A.   ORDINANCE 01-2025-26 (SECOND READING) An Ordinance of the City
          Clarksville, TN amending City Code Title 10 (Offenses - Miscellaneous), Chapter 1
          (Generally), Section 10-101 (Certain Misdemeanors under state law), to adopt by
          reference state traffic offenses, rules of the road, and certain other
          misdemeanors.

     B.   ORDINANCE 02-2025-26 (SECOND READING) An Ordinance
          amending Part II (Code of Ordinances), Title 13 (Utilities and Service), Chapter 3
          (Gas, Water, and Sewer Service) the City of Clarksville relative to ownership and
          maintenance of gas and water meters and services.

     C.   ORDINANCE 03-2025-26 (SECOND READING) An Ordinance authorizing the
          Mayor, or his designee, to conduct negotiations and to enter into an agreement for
          the purchase of easements and/or rights of way, or should negotiations fail, to
          pursue condemnation through the use of eminent domain for the acquisition of
          property for a public purpose for the Liberty Park Sidewalk Phase III Project.

     D.   ORDINANCE 05-2025-26 (SECOND READING) [ZONING CASE Z-29-2025]
          An Ordinance amending the zoning code and map of the City of Clarksville,
          application of Charles Thomas Jerles, for a zone change on a tract of land fronting
          on the north frontage of Bellamy Ln approximately 225 +/- feet west of the Bellamy
          Ln & Warfield Blvd intersection from C-2 General Commercial District to C-5
          Highway & Arterial Commercial District.

     E.   RESOLUTION 12-2025-26 A Resolution approving an appointment to the Arts &
          Heritage Development Council, Designations Board, Economic & Community
          Development Board, Gas & Plumbing Board and Parking Commission

     F.   RESOLUTION 13-2025-26 A Resolution approving a retail liquor store certificate of
          compliance for Tejaskumar S. Patel and Pooja S. Patel (Clarksville Bottle Shop,

10. Finance Committee: Chairman Stacey Streetman

     A.   ORDINANCE 07-2025-26 (FIRST READING) An Ordinance accepting the donation
          of certain real property from John T. Rochford to the City of Clarksville for the
          purpose of a park. Finance and Parks & Recreation Committees: Approval

     B.   ORDINANCE 18-2025-26 (FIRST READING) An Ordinance authorizing the Mayor,
          or his Designee, to conduct negotiations and to enter into an agreement for the
          purchase of real property for the purpose of constructing affordable housing in
          partnership with Appalachian Service Project. Finance Committe: Approval

     C.   RESOLUTION 08-2025-26 A City of Clarksville Resolution requesting the
          department of Human Resources perform a study with regard to a pay adjustment
          plan separate from the City General pay plan for the Fire Department
          and Police Department employees to target recruitment and retention, and return
          the results of the study to theCity Council. (Councilman Shakeenab) Finance
          Committee: Disapproval / Public Safety Committee: Approval

     D.   RESOLUTION 09-2025-26 A Resolution authorizing the issuance of interfund
          capital outlay notes in the aggregate principal amount of not to exceed eleven
          million, five hundred thousand dollars ($11,500,000) of the City of Clarksville,
          Tennessee; making provision for the issuance, sale and payment of said notes;

                                               4
         establishing the terms thereof and the disposition of proceeds therefrom; providing
         for the levy of taxes for the payment of principal of and interest on notes; and
         providing for reimbursement from federally tax-exempt obligations. Finance
         Committee: Approval

    E.   RESOLUTION 10-2025-26 A Resolution authorizing the issuance of not to exceed
         $61,000,000 in aggregate principal amount of one or more series of general
         obligation bonds of the City of Clarksville, Tennessee. Finance Committee:
         Approval

    F.   RESOLUTION 11-2025-26 A Resolution authorizing the issuance of not to exceed
         $76,000,000 in aggregate principal amount of general obligation refunding and
         improvement bonds of the City of Clarksville, Tennessee, in one or more series;
         making provision for the issuance, sale and payment of said bonds, establishing
         the terms thereof and the disposition of proceeds therefrom; and providing for the
         levy of taxes for the payment of principal of premium, if any, and interest on the
         bonds. Finance Committee: Approval
